evidence: Six parallel bug-fix agents covered disjoint scopes (views A/B/C, services+engine, models+design, tests).

Key agent fixes: ReviewSession reload-signature no longer resets the round on every rating; ActiveStudySession timer isolated into SessionTimerView so panels stop re-parsing per tick; Planner completion sheet no longer dismisses instantly; Settings reset writes a backup first; restore rolls back on failure; Onboarding previews use real seeded subjects; StudyPlan/cal/clock force-unwrap removals; TopicBrowser & SubjectDetail single-pass indexes; PredictiveGrade/Recommendations cached; BackupService empty-backup-dir guard; Gemini stream cancellable + temperature-0 reachable; add_grade requires numeric evidence.

New regression suites: GradeMapping, SM2 applyReview matrix, streak diff matrix, StudyPlan states, CurriculumProgress set/clear/effective, achievement XP/mastery/subject rules, E2E negation + non-destructive gate scenarios.

Fixed a critical test-host hang: BackupService/ARIA excludeFromBackupIfNeeded read resourceValues (getxattr) synchronously on the main thread and blocked indefinitely under the test host; both now set the exclusion once on a background queue without the blocking read.
Added 3 self-authored courses with full units/topics/subtopics + subject knowledge, plus a non-overlap regression test.
